title: 1959 AHSME Problem 13
statement: The arithmetic mean (average) of a set of \(50\) numbers is \(38.\) If two numbers, namely, \(45\) and \(55,\) are discarded, the mean of the remaining set of numbers is:

solutions.text:
The original sum is \(50\cdot38=1900.\) After removing \(45\) and \(55,\) the remaining sum is \(1800,\) so the new mean is \[ \frac{1800}{48}=37.5. \]

Therefore, the correct answer is D.
hints: Recover the original sum from the mean and number of entries
Subtract \(45+55\) and divide by the \(48\) remaining entries
